# Tessa Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Six years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tessa is a plump, rotund little girl with curly red hair and hazel eyes that crinkle shut when she falls asleep. She has a fair, Iris-like skin tone, but no dimples. Her mother considers her to be a very pretty child.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012)_

## Personality

Tessa is a proud, dignified, and somewhat prim little girl who likes to feel special and well-dressed. She takes her responsibilities seriously and can be quite obstinate and brave when trying to carry out an assignment. However, she is easily frightened by sudden threats, such as being chased by a dried codfish or having her hair pulled.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015)_

## Abilities

- Carrying out errands and messages dutifully  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To look pretty and deliver messages as instructed  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)</sub>

## History

Tessa was born at Hollowmere as the youngest child of Nell and Hugh Carrow. While her parents were away in Europe for three months, she stayed at Hollowmere under the care of Tabitha Pratt. Upon her parents' return, she was proudly dressed in her finest hat, silk dress, and beaded slippers to deliver a basket of early strawberries to the manse. On her way, she encountered Mary Stubbs, who tried to take the basket from her. Tessa resisted, determined to follow Tabitha's instructions. When Mary chased her with a dried codfish, Tessa fled in terror, tripped into a mud puddle in the village, and ruined her fine clothes. Miss Winifred rescued her and returned her to Hollowmere, where Tabitha cleaned and comforted her.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v5 c1 P3](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0003), [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P13](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0013), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015), [v5 c7 P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016)_
